verdict.why: onToolCall now fires only after the stream ends and only for tool calls still waiting on the client, so timing and call set change.

draft.detail: onToolCall fires once the response stream ends, for each tool call still waiting for a result; a server tool never reaches onToolCall.

source.quote: `onToolCall` fires once the response stream ends, for each tool call that is still waiting for a result. A server tool runs and resolves in the same stream, so it never reaches `onToolCall`.
